common_affordance: The explicitly defined certificate alternatives let all scheduling constraints be discarded except either one item's sequential processing times or one facility's nonoverlapping processing intervals, yielding direct additive lower bounds.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It has an off-by-one error: it tests p1+p2>T+1 and facility sums>T+1, but starts are at least 1 and the deadline is T+1, so the correct tests are p1+p2>T and sum>T.

recommended_edit: No valid single edit is available without changing the core task: the shared affordance is the mathematical structure of the required certificates, not incidental wording. If an edit is mandatory, the certificate definitions would need to be fundamentally redesigned so that they no longer isolate one job or one facility.
regression_risk: Any attempt to alter the deadline/start-time presentation while preserving the same inequalities may restore the defeated off-by-one solution or leave all surviving solutions correct.
